archetype: six-lot mobile-home park with branched road, management and shared services

orientation.residential_lots: three west and three east lots along the central road

shared_program: narrow north-south asphalt park road with six gravel lot branches
management reception/check-in, manager office, records/mail room and washroom
communal laundry, resident storage and maintenance workshop
road-end mail shelter, refuse point and electrical transformer
private garden, patio, water and utility connections for every lot
residential_program: living seating, storage and complete galley kitchen in every home
separate central bathroom/washroom and entrance storage in every home
private rear bedroom with bed and cupboards in every home
visible chassis, paired wheels, entrance step, hookups and roof trim
circulation: county connection enters the central park road between both shared-service buildings
three paired gravel branches reach all six trailer steps
management and laundry have public and rear service thresholds
each trailer's entrance hall independently connects its living room, bathroom and bedroom
central road continues to the mail and utility service terminus
damage_constraints: confine residential failures to the northwest living-room roof and southeast bedroom roof
confine shared-service failure to the communal workshop roof
preserve management, laundry, road and all six lot approaches
preserve four complete trailers plus surviving zones in both damaged trailers
derive abandonment, dead gardens and hostile occupation from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the road hierarchy and all six private lots read clearly at ground level
every mobile home has usable living, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom space
management and communal service buildings communicate distinct purposes
gardens, patios, chassis, steps and hookups remain readable after placement
hostile occupation is dangerous without locking the central road or surviving homes
terrain feathering seats the unusually large site without a hard rectangular shelf
